text: なんでか　しらない　けど　すげーなー！

structure.jp: なんでか　しらない　けど

patterns.name: 〜か (indirect question)
patterns.span: なんでか　しらない
patterns.explanation: A question word with か can sit inside a bigger sentence as the thing you know or don't know. なんでか　しらない = 'I don't know why'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with the meaning 'but'. しらない　けど = 'I don't know, but'.
